vaultSchemaWarning: This request names QuantaVault but does not match its exact signing schema. Review every raw field carefully.
vaultDelegateWarning: DelegateCall runs the target’s code with full control of the vault, including its funds and security setup.
vaultSecurityWarning: This call changes the vault or target contract’s security setup.
vaultOpaqueWarning: This approves an opaque value that may authorize another vault’s transaction. Verify this transaction in the QuantaVault app. Vault-to-vault approvals should use VaultApproval.
vaultUnknownWarning: Unknown selector. Verify the raw calldata in the QuantaVault app.
vaultInvalidWarning: Calldata could not be decoded completely. Verify the raw bytes in the QuantaVault app.
vaultDepthWarning: Further nested calls remain as raw bytes. Verify them in the QuantaVault app.
vaultSelectorHint: Function names are decoded from selectors. Verify the target contract’s identity and behavior.
vaultRefundError: Refund fields must be zero: the vault will reject this transaction. Approval is disabled.
vaultGasInfo: txGas is information only. It does not cap the inner call: the vault forwards all remaining gas.
vaultLongValidity: This approval remains valid for more than 30 days.
vaultMaxValidity: validUntil is the maximum value. This approval has no practical expiry.
vaultDateRange: Beyond the supported date range ({{value}} seconds since epoch)
vaultOpenRole: Open role: the account is the zero address. An open EXECUTOR role allows anyone to execute ready operations.
